// processImage decodes an uploaded image, resizes it to a thumbnail,
// and returns the thumbnail reader plus the original dimensions.
func processImage(file *multipart.FileHeader) (*bytes.Reader, int, int, error) {
    src, err := file.Open() // *multipart.FileHeader: a live HTTP-upload handle
    if err != nil {
        return nil, 0, 0, err
    }
    defer src.Close()

    img, err := imaging.Decode(src)
    // ... resize to a thumbnail, PNG-encode into out ...

    b := img.Bounds().Max
    return bytes.NewReader(out.Bytes()), b.X, b.Y, nil // *bytes.Reader + two ints
}
